transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because... well, I keep hearing voices. It's as clear as if somebody is standing right there in my little studio apartment with me. They say my name, and they keep telling me my work is being judged. But the house is completely quiet, and I know nobody else is there. It's just... it's happening a lot.
About how long ago did you first start hearing these voices?
Well, it's been going on for a while now. I'd say the voices, and... and this constant fear that my work is being watched and judged... it's been about nine months since it all started.
During these past nine months, have you experienced prolonged periods of feeling very down, sad, or hopeless?

No, I haven't really felt like that. I mean, I haven't been sad or hopeless. It's just... well, it's mostly just dealing with the voices and the worrying about being judged. But no, I haven't had long stretches of feeling down in the dumps or anything.
Have there been periods over these past nine months where you felt unusually energetic, wired, or on top of the world?

Yeah, there have been times like that. I'll get to feeling... well, just so bright and chosen. Like Greenville can't even hold all the plans I've got going on in my head. I get real energetic. 

But it's not always just feeling good, because I can go right from feeling on top of the world to snapping hard at someone over a tiny thing. Like, if one of my care clients just asks me to repeat myself, I'll completely lose my temper and snap at them. So yes, I do get really wired up like that.
Have you heard the voices or felt watched during times when your mood and energy levels were completely normal?

Yes, I have. There was a time... well, my energy had finally dropped back down, and I was sleeping more normally again. But even then, the voices didn't stop. And I still knew people were tracking my work and judging me. That went on for several weeks, even when my mood felt totally fine.
